Organisation address

Which address the organisation prints on locale pages. Shared pages and single-language sites always use the default locale's address.

Organisation address on locale pages

Business details

Each locale is its own business. The default locale is also your organisation; other locales use its values for empty fields (grey text). Changing the Language in Settings > General swaps the roles: the old default's own details move to its card here, and the new default's card becomes the organisation.

English en Default Office

This is also your organisation.
